subject: Private VPC / On-prem recap: networking, data residency, next steps
messages:
From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: NetworkSec <netsec@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC discovery - quick recap request

Hi Marissa / Dev,

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Wanted to capture the key constraints on our side and make sure we're aligned before I loop in procurement/legal. High level:

- Primary drivers: HIPAA + state-level data residency, and an upcoming audit in Q1 2027.
- Preferred deployment: Private VPC (customer-managed networking) or fully on-prem if needed; must be able to support an air-gapped option for certain workloads.
- Networking constraints: no outbound internet egress from patient data processing subnet; only specific host-to-host connections allowed to a small set of IPs.
- Auth/KMS: we need integration with our AWS KMS/HSM and key rotation policies; secrets must never be exported to Redwood-managed keys.
- Logging/audit: 1 year retention for audit logs; SOC 2 evidence will be required during procurement.

Next steps from our side: attach network topology + SOC2 summary. Can you confirm whether Redwood's Private package supports: 1) air-gapped install (air-gap installer + local registry), 2) KMS/HSM integration, and 3) an on-prem upgrade path?

Also, can you propose 2x 60-minute slots next week for a technical deep dive (networking + security)?

Thanks,
Jordan
Director, Platform Security
Acme Health

--
Attachment: acme-network-topology.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: acme-soc2-summary.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-18T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC discovery - quick recap request

Jordan,

Really appreciate the clear summary and for sharing the attachments. Below is our recap from today's call and proposed next steps. Please flag anything I missed.

Recap (agreed pain points & constraints)
- Compliance & data residency: HIPAA + state residency. Customer data must remain in Acme-managed VPC or on-prem environment.
- Air-gap requirement: Some processing tiers must be fully air-gapped with no outbound egress.
- Networking policy: Strict host allowlists; only specific egress to management/control plane IPs allowed.
- Key management: Integration with Acme KMS/HSM and no export of customer keys.
- Audit & logs: 12 months retention; ability to stream audit logs to customer SIEM (we support S3/ODR endpoints).

What Redwood supports (summary)
- Private deployment options: Private VPC and on-prem installer. We provide an air-gap-friendly installer bundle and support private container registries.
- KMS/HSM: We support customer-managed KMS via KMIP (HSM) and AWS KMS; keys remain under customer control.
- Networking: Configurable control plane agent that can operate over a customer TCP TLS tunnel; offline install supported for fully isolated environments.
- Audit/logging: We can stream logs to your S3 or push to your SIEM over approved endpoints; retention configurable.

Open items / clarifying questions for Acme
1) For air-gapped workloads, what CI/CD/update cadence do you expect (monthly vs quarterly)?
2) Please confirm the exact IP range(s) we should allow for management/control plane (we can also run over a VPN/Direct Connect).
3) Any vendor restrictions for third-party OS packages in the air-gapped environment?

Proposed next steps
- Technical deep dive (networking + security): we can do Tue 8/24 10:00-11:00 PT or Wed 8/25 14:00-15:00 PT. Stephanie (Solutions Eng) will lead.
- We'll prepare a short architecture diagram showing on-prem vs private VPC flows and a preliminary SOW outline for air-gapped option.
- If helpful, sign the mutual NDA and we'll share more detailed runbooks.

I've attached our private deployment diagram for reference.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0104

--
Attachment: redwood-private-arch.png (image/png)

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-19T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC discovery - quick recap request

Jordan — quick technical note from me:

- Air-gap installer: we provide an OCI bundle + install guide that can be loaded from a private registry. For fully isolated installs we can provide an offline RPM/DEB bundle and a script to seed the local registry.
- KMS/HSM: we have a KMIP connector and an AWS KMS shim. For HSM-backed keys we can work with your HSM vendor to validate the KMIP flow (we have done this with Thales/Entrust).
- Control plane comms: if you require no outbound to the public internet, we can run the control plane over a Direct Connect/VPN tunnel to a management endpoint in your VPC; otherwise we offer a customer-hosted control plane option.
- Upgrade path: online upgrades are supported, but for air-gapped installs we recommend a quarterly validated upgrade window with staged testing.

I'll bring our install checklist and a sample network ACL diagram to the deep dive.

— Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
